semantically_equivalent_models.justification: While VGG-16 is a distinct model, it is similar in architecture to VGG-11 as a part of the VGG family developed by the Visual Geometry Group at Oxford.

parent_models.justification: VGG is a broader model family which includes multiple architectures like VGG-11, VGG-16, and others, making it a parent to VGG-11.

closest_parent_model.justification: VGG is the direct family that encompasses the VGG-11 model, making it the closest parent model.

closest_child_model.justification: Between the models in the list, VGG-16, although not strictly a child, represents a more specific variation of VGG architectures compared to VGG-11.

sibling_models.justification: VGG-16, like VGG-11, belongs to the same VGG family of models and represents a variant in the number of layers, therefore serving as a sibling model.

closest_sibling_model.justification: VGG-16 is structurally and conceptually closest to VGG-11 as it belongs to the same VGG family and represents a sister architecture.

unrelated_models.justification: VG is an unrelated model without clear ties to the VGG architectures based on naming and known architecture purposes.
GVP is unrelated to VGG architectures, focusing on a different domain of model applications.
VQ does not match the VGG architectural series or concept, indicating no direct relationship.
VI is unrelated and does not fall under the VGG model umbrella.
VBPI-GNN represents a different model architecture, unrelated to VGG.
GCN, or Graph Convolutional Networks, are a separate class of models unrelated to VGG.
SwinV2 represents a different architecture class (vision transformers) unrelated to VGG models.
GT is unrelated to VGG, with no known architectural or developmental ties.
RealNVP is a different model class focused on normalizing flows, unrelated to the VGG series.
VIRL is unrelated to the VGG model series based on name and architectural purpose.
SVC does not align with VGG models and has no shared development history or architecture.
VilBERTDisc is unrelated as it pertains to transformers and language models.
LightGCN is a different architecture, part of graph convolutional networks, distinct from VGG.
PCL v1 does not share its framework or intended application purpose with VGG models.
SGC-1 is a simplified graph convolution model, irrelevant to the VGG family.
EGCN is a model belonging to the graph convolution domain, unrelated to the VGG architecture.
Vaprl is a domain-specific model, unrelated to VGG.
DeepLabv3 is a semantic segmentation model that doesn't share architectural history with VGG models.
